import os, re, subprocess
from collections import defaultdict

repo = "/bench/repo"
internal = os.path.join(repo, "internal")

# Collect declared functions/methods in internal/ (non-test)
decls = []  # (qual_name, short_name, path, is_method, recv_type)
decl_re_func = re.compile(r'^func\s+(?:\([^)]+\)\s+)?(\w+)\s*\(', re.MULTILINE)
decl_re_method = re.compile(r'^func\s+\((\w+)\s+\*?(\w+)\)\s+(\w+)\s*\(', re.MULTILINE)

for root, dirs, files in os.walk(internal):
    for f in files:
        if not f.endswith('.go') or f.endswith('_test.go'):
            continue
        path = os.path.join(root, f)
        rel = os.path.relpath(path, repo)
        pkg_dir = os.path.dirname(rel)
        pkg = os.path.basename(pkg_dir)
        text = open(path, encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore').read()
        for m in decl_re_method.finditer(text):
            recv_var, recv_type, name = m.groups()
            decls.append((f"{recv_type}.{name}", name, rel, True, recv_type, pkg))
        # functions without receiver - skip methods already captured
        for m in re.finditer(r'^func\s+(\w+)\s*\(', text, re.MULTILINE):
            name = m.group(1)
            # crude skip if it's actually a method line
            line_start = m.start()
            line = text.rfind('\n', 0, line_start)+1
            line_text = text[line:text.find('\n', line_start)]
            if line_text.strip().startswith('func (') and ')' in line_text.split('func ')[1].split(name)[0]:
                continue
            decls.append((name, name, rel, False, None, pkg))

# Search all go files for references
go_files = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(repo):
    if '/web/' in root or '/gen/' in root or '/.git/' in root:
        continue
    for f in files:
        if f.endswith('.go'):
            go_files.append(os.path.join(root, f))

# Build counts per declaration using word-boundary search for short name
# For methods, also search RecvType.Name and pkg.Name patterns
counts = defaultdict(set)  # qual -> set of caller files

for qual, short, path, is_method, recv_type, pkg in decls:
    patterns = [rf'\b{re.escape(short)}\s*\(']
    if is_method:
        patterns.append(rf'\b{re.escape(recv_type)}\.{re.escape(short)}\s*\(')
        patterns.append(rf'\b{re.escape(pkg)}\.{re.escape(short)}\s*\(')
    else:
        patterns.append(rf'\b{re.escape(pkg)}\.{re.escape(short)}\s*\(')
    
    combined = re.compile('|'.join(patterns))
    for gf in go_files:
        rel_gf = os.path.relpath(gf, repo)
        if rel_gf == path:
            # count internal same-file and same-package; exclude declaration line only roughly
            pass
        try:
            content = open(gf, encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore').read()
        except:
            continue
        if combined.search(content):
            # exclude if only match is the declaration in same file (heuristic)
            if rel_gf == path:
                # remove declaration occurrences
                decl_pat = re.compile(rf'^func\s+(?:\([^)]+\)\s+)?{re.escape(short)}\s*\(', re.MULTILINE)
                content_no_decl = decl_pat.sub('', content)
                if not combined.search(content_no_decl):
                    continue
            counts[qual + ' @ ' + path].add(rel_gf)

# Sort by fan-in
ranked = sorted(((k, len(v)) for k, v in counts.items()), key=lambda x: -x[1])
for k, n in ranked[:25]:
    print(f"{n}\t{k}")
